description: Estimate what a Southwest Airlines ticket earns (miles or points, and status credit where it applies), using cwsi.net's calculator and the airline's published rules. Unofficial.

card.description: Paying with a Southwest card. none = No; PL = Plus (+2 per $1); PR = Premier (+3 per $1); PY = Priority (+4 per $1). From 2027 every Southwest credit card also earns 1 TQP per $1 spent.

fare.description: Fare type. CE = Choice Extra (14 per $1; 10 from 2027); CP = Choice Preferred (10 per $1; 8 from 2027); CH = Choice (6 per $1); BA = Basic (2 per $1).

flights.description: Flights on this ticket. Status can also be earned by flights: from 2027, 25 for Silver, 50 for Gold and 100 for Platinum; in 2026, 20 for A-List and 40 for A-List Preferred.

price.description: Ticket price (base fare, without taxes and fees) in US dollars. Shown on your receipt as the base fare, before taxes and fees.

status.description: Your Rapid Rewards status. Base = Base (No status); A-List = A-List (+25%); A-List Preferred = A-List Preferred (+100%). For flights through Dec 31, 2026. Only applies to some choices of the other fields; ignored otherwise.

tier.description: Your Rapid Rewards tier. Base = Base (No tier); Silver = Silver (+40%); Gold = Gold (+60%); Platinum = Platinum (+120%). For flights from Jan 1, 2027. A-List becomes Silver and A-List Preferred becomes Gold. Only applies to some choices of the other fields; ignored otherwise.

when.description: When do you fly?. 2026 = Through Dec 31, 2026; 2027 = From Jan 1, 2027. Southwest's new Rapid Rewards starts with flights on Jan 1, 2027.

name: calculate_southwest_points
title: Southwest Rapid Rewards Calculator
